WHERE instruction = (SELECT instruction FROM read_csv('datasets/OpenRCA/local_agent/bank/out/tasks.csv') WHERE task_id=1);

WITH span AS (
  SELECT ts, cmdb_id, span_id, parent_id, duration
  FROM 'datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/trace_span.parquet'
  WHERE day BETWEEN DATE '2021-03-03' AND DATE '2021-03-05'
    AND ts BETWEEN '2021-03-04 09:00:00' AND '2021-03-04 20:00:00'
), selft AS (
  SELECT p.ts, p.cmdb_id, p.duration - coalesce(c.kids,0) AS self_ms
  FROM span p LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent_id, sum(duration) kids FROM span GROUP BY 1) c ON c.parent_id = p.span_id
)
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL 1 MINUTE, ts) t, count(*) n, max(self_ms) mx
FROM selft WHERE self_ms > 4000 AND cmdb_id IN ('MG01','MG02')
GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY 1;

WITH mc AS (
  SELECT ts, cmdb_id, kpi_name, value
  FROM 'datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/metric_container.parquet'
  WHERE day BETWEEN DATE '2021-03-03' AND DATE '2021-03-05' AND ts::DATE = DATE '2021-03-04'
    AND kpi_name NOT LIKE 'Container-DOCKER%'
),
b AS (SELECT cmdb_id, kpi_name, median(value) med, stddev_pop(value) sd, min(value) bmin, max(value) bmax
      FROM mc WHERE ts BETWEEN '2021-03-04 11:00:00' AND '2021-03-04 14:45:00' GROUP BY 1,2),
w AS (SELECT * FROM mc WHERE ts BETWEEN '2021-03-04 14:50:00' AND '2021-03-04 15:20:00')
SELECT w.cmdb_id, w.kpi_name,
       round(max(abs(w.value-b.med)/greatest(b.sd,0.02*abs(b.med),1e-9)),1) maxz,
       round(any_value(b.med),3) med, round(any_value(b.bmin),3) bmin, round(any_value(b.bmax),3) bmax,
       round(min(w.value),3) wmin, round(max(w.value),3) wmax,
       arg_max(w.ts, abs(w.value-b.med)) t_peak
FROM w JOIN b USING (cmdb_id, kpi_name)
GROUP BY 1,2
HAVING max(w.value) > any_value(b.bmax) OR min(w.value) < any_value(b.bmin)
ORDER BY maxz DESC LIMIT 25;

WITH mc AS (
  SELECT ts, cmdb_id, kpi_name, value FROM 'datasets/OpenRCA/data/bank/parquet/metric_container.parquet'
  WHERE day BETWEEN DATE '2021-03-03' AND DATE '2021-03-05' AND ts::DATE = DATE '2021-03-04'
    AND kpi_name NOT LIKE 'Container-DOCKER%'),
pre AS (SELECT cmdb_id,kpi_name, avg(value) m, stddev_pop(value) sd, count(*) n FROM mc
        WHERE ts BETWEEN '2021-03-04 13:30:00' AND '2021-03-04 14:56:00' GROUP BY 1,2),
post AS (SELECT cmdb_id,kpi_name, avg(value) m, count(*) n FROM mc
        WHERE ts BETWEEN '2021-03-04 14:57:00' AND '2021-03-04 15:30:00' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT pre.cmdb_id, pre.kpi_name, round(pre.m,3) pre_avg, round(post.m,3) post_avg,
       round(abs(post.m-pre.m)/greatest(pre.sd,1e-9),1) step_z, pre.n pre_n, post.n post_n
FROM pre JOIN post USING (cmdb_id,kpi_name)
WHERE pre.n>=8 AND post.n>=5 AND pre.sd>0
ORDER BY step_z DESC LIMIT 20;
